notes.title: Christmas Updates
notes.content:
A Christmas tree has been planted in the middle of your neighbourhood, and it will be there until the holidays are over. Here is a summary of the recent content additions/changes:
[list]
[*] It is possible to receive promotions at work if you are performing well. These can be given up to five times, each increasing salary by 10%.
[*] You can leave your job and start another by going to the job centre, located at the south end of the town square.
[*] The derelict church has been added.
[*] The priest can be spoken to. He has a new quest/task on which to send the player. 
[*] Fight with the evil entity that lurks beneath the church. This fight is intended for players who have high stats.
[*] NPC dialogue changes and additions.
[/list]
